svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut one 1,161 mm length of 30 x 30 x 3 angle; ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 9 mm hole 12 from each end on the flat leg's centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the outer face of the south legs' outward legs, above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: south cross member, from the west leg (275 above the ground) up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the east leg (470 above the ground), at 10 degrees; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: other leg stands out at its lower edge. One M8 bolt each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It stops the stand racking sideways. The north end needs none: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: box, bolted to both rails, ties the two side frames together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the drain tube passes above it with room to spare.
